usage: The word '姑媽' refers specifically to your father's sister and is used as a noun.
'姑媽' can be used when talking about family members or relatives on your father's side.
You can use '我嘅姑媽' to say 'my aunt' on your father's side.
In conversations about family gatherings or relatives, '姑媽' is commonly mentioned.
'姑媽' is different from your mother's sister, which is called ‘姨媽’.
